attributes.name: Circle of Chaos
attributes.powers: Discard this card to examine the top card of each location deck. After you examine a boon, banish it; after you examine a bane, each character at that location is dealt 1 Force damage. Then shuffle each location deck.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at a Divine 15 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
